items.source: Streamable-HTTP - The Streamable HTTP transport allows MCP servers to operate as independent processes that can handle multiple client connections using HTTP POST and GET requests, with optional Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming for multiple server messages. It replaces the SSE transport. To enable the STREAMABLE protocol, set spring.ai.mcp.server.protocol=STREAMABLE.
items.translation: Streamable-HTTP - Streamable HTTP 传输层允许 MCP 服务器作为独立进程运行，能够使用 HTTP POST 和 GET 请求处理多个客户端连接，并可选地支持用于多条服务器消息的服务器发送事件（SSE）流式传输。它取代了 SSE 传输层。要启用 STREAMABLE 协议，请设置 spring.ai.mcp.server.protocol=STREAMABLE。

items.source: STDIO - In process (e.g. server runs inside the host application) protocol. Communication is over standard in and standard out. To enable the STDIO set spring.ai.mcp.server.stdio=true.
items.translation: STDIO - 进程内协议（例如服务器在主机应用程序内部运行）。通信通过标准输入和标准输出进行。要启用 STDIO，请设置 spring.ai.mcp.server.stdio=true。

items.source: Stateless - Stateless MCP servers are designed for simplified deployments where session state is not maintained between requests. They are ideal for microservices architectures and cloud-native deployments. To enable the STATELESS protocol, set spring.ai.mcp.server.protocol=STATELESS.
items.translation: 无状态 - 无状态 MCP 服务器专为简化部署而设计，在这些部署中请求之间不会维护会话状态。它们非常适合微服务架构和云原生部署。要启用 STATELESS 协议，请设置 spring.ai.mcp.server.protocol=STATELESS。

items.source: Synchronous Server - The default server type implemented using McpSyncServer. It is designed for straightforward request-response patterns in your applications. To enable this server type, set spring.ai.mcp.server.type=SYNC in your configuration. When activated, it automatically handles the configuration of synchronous tool specifications.
items.translation: 同步服务器 - 使用 McpSyncServer 实现的默认服务器类型。 它专为应用程序中简单直接的请求 - 响应模式而设计。 要启用此服务器类型，请在配置文件中设置 spring.ai.mcp.server.type=SYNC。 激活后，它将自动处理同步工具规范的配置。

items.source: Asynchronous Server - The asynchronous server implementation uses McpAsyncServer and is optimized for non-blocking operations. To enable this server type, configure your application with spring.ai.mcp.server.type=ASYNC. This server type automatically sets up asynchronous tool specifications with built-in Project Reactor support.
items.translation: 异步服务器 - 异步服务器实现使用 McpAsyncServer，并针对非阻塞操作进行了优化。 要启用此服务器类型，请在应用程序中配置 spring.ai.mcp.server.type=ASYNC。 该服务器类型会自动设置异步工具规范，并内置 Project Reactor 支持。

items.source: McpSyncServerExchange/McpAsyncServerExchange - Full server context for advanced operations
items.translation: McpSyncServerExchange/McpAsyncServerExchange - 用于高级操作的完整服务器上下文

items.source: SSE - Server-sent events protocol for real-time updates. The server operates as an independent process that can handle multiple client connections.
items.translation: SSE - 用于实时更新的服务器发送事件协议。该服务器作为一个独立进程运行，可处理多个客户端连接。

items.source: By default, the McpTransportContext is empty (McpTransportContext.EMPTY). This is by design, to keep the MCP server transport-agnostic.
items.translation: 默认情况下，McpTransportContext 为空（即 McpTransportContext.EMPTY）。 这是有意为之的设计，以保持 MCP 服务器传输无关性。

items.source: Model Context Protocol (MCP) Servers are programs that expose specific capabilities to AI applications through standardized protocol interfaces. Each server provides focused functionality for a particular domain.
items.translation: 模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器是通过标准化协议接口向 AI 应用程序暴露特定功能的程序。每个服务器都为特定领域提供专注的功能。

items.source: The Spring AI MCP Server Boot Starters provide auto-configuration for setting up MCP Servers in Spring Boot applications. They enable seamless integration of MCP server capabilities with Spring Boot’s auto-configuration system.
items.translation: Spring AI MCP Server 启动器为在 Spring Boot 应用中配置 MCP 服务器 提供了自动配置支持。它们实现了 MCP 服务器功能与 Spring Boot 自动配置系统的无缝集成。

items.source: Annotation-based server development with automatic bean scanning and registration
items.translation: 基于注解的服务器开发，支持自动 Bean 扫描与注册。

items.source: MCP Servers support multiple protocol and transport mechanisms. Use the dedicated starter and the correct spring.ai.mcp.server.protocol property to configure your server:
